name: NCL Research & Financial Services Limited
about: NCL Research & Financial Services Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in finance and investment activities in India. The company invests and trades in shares and securities in equity and FNO segments. It also provides secured and unsecured loans. In addition, the company trades in commodities and textiles. Further, it is involved in the other capital market-related activities. The company serves micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), small and medium enterprises (SMEs), corporates, and non-corporates. NCL Research & Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
